ops.name: create
ops.description: Create a task with executable acceptance and explicit writable paths.

ops.name: update
ops.description: Edit task content; worker status/lease mutations are prohibited.

ops.name: admin_update
ops.description: Administrative correction; requires configured server admin token and reason.

ops.name: dep
ops.description: Add typed dependencies; blocks edges are acyclic and gates await named approval.

ops.name: dep_list
ops.description: List typed dependencies for an issue or store.

ops.name: dep_remove
ops.description: Remove a specific dependency edge.

ops.name: ready
ops.description: Read ready task data with explicit filters.

ops.name: list
ops.description: Read list task data with explicit filters.

ops.name: query
ops.description: Read query task data with explicit filters.

ops.name: count
ops.description: Read count task data with explicit filters.

ops.name: next
ops.description: Read qualified leaf tasks in a goal subtree; does not claim ownership.

ops.name: acquire
ops.description: Atomically select qualified work and return claim plus complete bounded contract.

ops.name: claim
ops.description: Claim executable work; finalize:true explicitly claims a container after descendant acceptance. meta.autorun enqueues an outbox autorun job for external runners.

ops.name: claim_next
ops.description: Atomically claim the next qualified task within goal/lane.

ops.name: heartbeat
ops.description: Refresh a live matching lease and read cancellation intent.

ops.name: unclaim
ops.description: Release only your current fenced live claim.

ops.name: reclaim
ops.description: Recover expired claims; inspect stale facts and ownership before use.

ops.name: verify
ops.description: Run declared oracle with bounded resources; persist source-bound verification receipt.

ops.name: close
ops.description: Close only with valid matching source-bound verification receipt; honors meta.review_required, meta.attest_required and meta.budget_gate (cost rollup must fit budget_eur).

ops.name: reopen
ops.description: Reopen your/controller task with a fresh epoch; admin token for administrative recovery.

ops.name: delete
ops.description: Administrative task deletion with configured admin authority.

ops.name: defer
ops.description: Defer task until explicit release or due timestamp.

ops.name: undefer
ops.description: Make a deferred task eligible for qualification.

ops.name: show
ops.description: Read complete task, dependencies and bounded recent events.

ops.name: search
ops.description: Search task text with a bounded result limit.

ops.name: children
ops.description: Read immediate goal/task children.

ops.name: label
ops.description: Add or remove task labels.

ops.name: rename
ops.description: Rename task identity and related references administratively.

ops.name: note
ops.description: Append an audit note; task status remains unchanged.

ops.name: changes
ops.description: Record a compact file-edit summary for a task: path, +adds/-dels and hunk line ranges from the real git worktree (sis changes <id> [--repo P] [--base R] [--patch]). Append-only evidence — no code stored unless --patch snapshots a bounded diff. Identical consecutive diffs dedup unless force:true. sis close records the same automatically.

ops.name: comments
ops.description: Read task notes.

ops.name: history
ops.description: Read ordered task events.

ops.name: checkpoint
ops.description: Persist bounded source-bound progress and next safe step under a valid lease.

ops.name: handoff
ops.description: Checkpoint bounded progress and release the fenced claim in one step so a successor agent can claim immediately; `to` names the intended successor.

ops.name: resume
ops.description: Read current contract and last checkpoint with drift/cancellation information.

ops.name: who
ops.description: Dirty-worktree attribution: maps each dirty/untracked path in a git repo to the recorded changes event (claim/actor) that produced it. Orphaned paths with no matching event surface explicitly — answers 'wem gehoert dieser Stand?'.

repo.description: Path inside the worktree; defaults to cwd.

ops.name: cancel
ops.description: Request cancellation as current worker or declared controller.

ops.name: cancel_ack
ops.description: Acknowledge cancellation, end the live lease and fence old work.

ops.name: contract
ops.description: Read complete stable task contract and its revision.

ops.name: brief
ops.description: Render token-budgeted task context without dropping mandatory acceptance.

ops.name: tokens
ops.description: Count selected tiktoken encoding; explicitly separate count from model billing.

ops.name: context
ops.description: Read stable project identity, database path, capabilities and current stats.

ops.name: capabilities
ops.description: Discover operation names and store identity; request schemas only when needed.

ops.name: watch
ops.description: Read durable events after cursor or subscribe with bounded wait.

ops.name: lint
ops.description: Read lint diagnostics without dispatching work.

ops.name: types
ops.description: Read types diagnostics without dispatching work.

ops.name: statuses
ops.description: Read statuses diagnostics without dispatching work.

ops.name: prime
ops.description: Read prime diagnostics without dispatching work.

ops.name: orphans
ops.description: Read orphans diagnostics without dispatching work.

ops.name: stats
ops.description: Read stats diagnostics without dispatching work.

ops.name: review
ops.description: Read review diagnostics without dispatching work.

ops.name: stale
ops.description: Read expired task leases.

ops.name: remember
ops.description: Persist a project-scoped learning value.

ops.name: recall
ops.description: Read project-scoped learning values.

ops.name: export
ops.description: Export project state for audit or backup.

ops.name: import
ops.description: Import administrative event state with explicit admin authority. bd format is conflict-aware: live claims and closed issues are reported, never silently overwritten (force:true to reopen).

ops.name: batch
ops.description: Apply a bounded atomic mutation batch; verifier execution is excluded.

ops.name: budget_claim
ops.description: Reserve finite nonnegative task budget atomically.

ops.name: outbox_list
ops.description: Read unprocessed transactional lessons.

ops.name: outbox_done
ops.description: Confirm successful processing. Leased deliveries require matching actor, delivery epoch and unexpired lease.

ops.name: outbox_fail
ops.description: Record failed outbox processing. Leased deliveries require matching actor, delivery epoch and unexpired lease.

ops.name: compact
ops.description: Archive old events and reap only expired ephemeral task hints.

ops.name: gate
ops.description: Read or set a named approval gate; unknown gates are closed.

ops.name: gate_list
ops.description: Read named approval gates.

ops.name: slot_acquire
ops.description: Acquire a fenced expiring merge slot.

ops.name: slot_release
ops.description: Release your matching fenced merge slot.

ops.name: slot_list
ops.description: Read merge-slot holders and epochs.

ops.name: epic
ops.description: Read task hierarchy with completion rollup.

ops.name: dup_scan
ops.description: Find likely duplicate tasks before creating new work.

ops.name: q
ops.description: Capture a task using the create contract.

ops.name: goal
ops.description: Create a named goal container with final acceptance.

ops.name: sub
ops.description: Create a child task under a goal without a blocking parent edge.

ops.name: plan
ops.description: Create atomic goal tree and validated internal dependencies; save or reuse a named template.

ops.name: goal_tree
ops.description: Read named goal hierarchy and progress.

ops.name: goal_done
ops.description: Check subtree completion; caller still needs verified final goal acceptance.

ops.name: snapshot
ops.description: Write the git-diffable <db>.issues.jsonl mirror (one upsert line per issue, deps embedded, sorted by id). Runs automatically after every committed write op; SIS_SNAPSHOT=0 disables.

ops.name: attest
ops.description: Attach a structured machine-checkable attestation (junit/coverage/smoke/artifact/custom/run) to the active claim, bound to contract revision and source fingerprint. kind:"run" executes cmd store-side — the receipt is not forgeable client-side. Required kinds via meta.attest_required are enforced at close.

ops.name: cost_add
ops.description: Append a cost entry (tokens/cents) to an issue's durable ledger; idempotent via idem key.

ops.name: cost_list
ops.description: List cost ledger entries, filterable by issue/actor/run_id/wave.

ops.name: cost_rollup
ops.description: Roll up costs over the container subtree of id (meta.parent + id-prefix): totals plus per-issue/actor/wave breakdown and budget reference.

ops.name: outbox_export
ops.description: Export raw, pgboss-sql, hatchet or temporal jobs. Explicit actor reserves deliveries with ttl 5..3600 seconds, fenced ACK and at most three attempts. Without actor, legacy preview/drain semantics apply.

ops.name: learn
ops.description: Honest learning aggregates over the ledger: attest/proof pass rates, cost (cents/tokens) and time-to-accepted grouped by actor|wave|kind|issue — the posterior for bandit/routing decisions, no invented score.

ops.name: sync_export
ops.description: Emit a deterministic sis-sync bundle (schema-stamped issues+deps, memories, proof+attest receipts; events with events:true) for multi-machine replication.

ops.name: sync_import
ops.description: Admin: merge a sis-sync bundle — issue/deps upsert, memory LWW by updated_at, receipts by primary key; live claims are never overwritten and report as conflicts.

ops.name: spans
ops.description: Read back OTel-shaped span lines emitted under SIS_EMIT for observability of claim/verify/close and other requests.
